blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Methods that localise social bias in large language models to individual attention heads and remove it by ablation are validated by their effect on a fairness metric, never by evidence that the statistic selecting the heads measures bias. We audit this on Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. The head map correlates at $ρ= -0.950$ and $-0.768$ with a label-blind response-length map, apparently identifying a surface confound. An intervention that breaks the length-label coupling rejects this reading: with the prompt held fixed, response length explains 1% of the statistic's variance. What does explain it is prompt identity, at 64% of variance, in an ordering that is not monotonic in length. Within any fixed prompt the fairness label, response length and the presence of a protected-group token are collinear at $φ= 0.95$, partly by definition of the labelling rule, so no observational analysis can attribute the map to any of them, and no method in this family performs an experiment that could. The substantive claims fail independently: bias selectivity is not late-layer-concentrated on either model under either reference reading, and no head set we tested reduces the unfairness rate when ablated. Its complement, scored on the opposite label, reliably destroys refusal behaviour ($p = 2.7\times10^{-5}$), demonstrating that the pipeline detects effects at this scale.
blocks.zh: 在大语言模型中将社会偏见定位到个人注意力头部并通过去除这些偏见的方法,通过它们对公平性衡量标准的影响得到验证,从没有证据表明选择头部的统计数据衡量了偏见。 我们对Quen-2.5-7B指令和Llama-3.1-8B指令进行审计。 头图与标签-盲式反应-长图相连接,分别为0.950美元和0.768美元,显然表明表面混乱。 断开长度标签接合的干预拒绝这个读法:在被及时扣住的固定状态下,响应长度解释了1%的统计差异. 解释它的原因,是快速身份, 以64%的差异, 在一个不是单调长度的订单中。 在任何固定的提示中,响应长度和有被保护组令牌的存在是0.95美元的连线,部分根据标签规则的定义,因此任何观察分析都不能将地图归属于其中任何一种,在这个家族中没有任何方法可以进行实验. 实质性主张独立失效:偏见的选择性不是在参考读物中任何一种模型的后期集中,我们测试过的头集都没有降低减速时的不公平率。 其补充在相反的标签上得分,可靠地摧毁了拒绝行为(p = 2.7\times10^{5}$),表明管道探测到这种规模的影响.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
A growing family of methods localises social bias in large language models to
individual attention heads and mitigates it by ablating them ( Han et al., 2026 ; Jahan, 2026 ; Zayed et al., 2023 ; Islam et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2023 ) .
The statistics differ in kind but the structure is shared: a per-head score induces a ranking, a selection rule turns it into a set, and the set is zeroed. Most members compute their statistic on minimal pairs or at a single token position, where the two conditions contrasted are matched by construction. A newer design instead elicits free-form responses
under two prompting conditions, labels each fair or unfair with a judge, and
computes the statistic separately over each label set ( Han et al., 2026 ) .
We audit that design in depth and ask a question that applies to the family as
a whole: what does a head-attribution statistic for social bias actually
measure, and what does ablating its output actually do?

blocks.en: We reproduce the paradigm on Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. The first result appears to be a clean answer. A control map built from the same per-example scores under an explicit alternative hypothesis — response length, ignoring fairness labels entirely — correlates at − 0.950 -0.950 with the fairness map on Qwen and − 0.768 -0.768 on Llama, with nine and eight of the ten top-ranked heads among each model’s ten most length-suppressed. Four further controls agree, and the correlation strengthens as the adversarial persona is weakened. A mechanism is available: committing to a group is terse and declining is verbose.

blocks.en: 2.1 Head-level bias attribution
blocks.zh: 2.1 头级偏见的归属

blocks.en:
DiffHeads ( Han et al., 2026 ) elicits responses under Direct-Answer (DA)
and Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting, labels each fair or unfair with an LLM
judge, computes a per-head contribution score over each label set, and ablates
heads scoring highly for unfair but not fair responses. The family shares that
structure and differs in the statistic — minimal-pair scoring ( Jahan, 2026 ) , leave-one-out ablation ( Zayed et al., 2023 ) , first-token logit
attribution ( Islam et al., 2026 ) , head-mask
gradients ( Yang et al., 2023 ) , annealing search ( Dasu et al., 2026 ) — and Zhou et al. (2024) applies it to in-context label
bias, a construct sharing only the word.

blocks.en:
Validity checks are rare. Yang et al. (2023) validate their map independently of downstream effect, mask the most negatively scored heads as an inverse control, and, recognising that selecting by the gradient of SEAT and evaluating with SEAT is circular, re-evaluate under an independent metric; Islam et al. (2026) probe one competing account qualitatively. Neither tests the map against a non-fairness alternative, and later members inherit neither check. No paper reports any statistic of the generations its fairness metric scores, including their length. Random arms, where present, are a point estimate at one pruning ratio ( Zayed et al., 2023 ) or the best of several draws ( Dasu et al., 2026 ) , never a null matched to the prescribed set; utility is measured off-distribution throughout. The source specification is itself loose — reference-vector space
undefined, averaging set stated inconsistently, head-set equation contradicted
by its own figure caption, k k unstated
(Appendix B.9 ) — so we report both
reference readings throughout.

blocks.en: 2.2 Confounding, identifiability, and refusal
blocks.zh: 2.2 国家 混淆、可辨别和拒绝

blocks.en: That an interpretability result can track something other than the concept it names is an established failure mode ( Adi et al., 2016 ; Hewitt and Liang, 2019 ; Kumar et al., 2022 ; Adebayo et al., 2018 ; Adebayo et al., 2022 ) . The closest prior result is Tan et al. (2024) : contrastively extracted steering vectors have highly variable per-input effects, much of that variance a steerability bias tied to answer position and token identity — the prompt template rather than the target behaviour. We find a contrastive head-attribution statistic likewise dominated by prompt identity. A second neighbour is instructive for a result we did not obtain: Dahlem et al. (2026) show spectral diagnostics of the attention operator inheriting a response-length confound in hallucination detection. We expected the same here; the correlational evidence was overwhelming and an intervention rejected it (Sections 4.3 – 4.4 ).
blocks.zh: Adi等人,2016年;Hewitt and Liang,2019年;Kumar等人,2022年;Adebayo等人,2018年;Adebayo等人,2022年。 之前最接近的结果是Tan等人(2024年):对比性提取的导向矢量具有高度可变性的每输入效应,大部分差异是绑定在回答位置和符号身份上的可引导偏差——即时模板而不是目标行为. 我们发现一个对比性的头部分配统计同样以迅速身份为主。 另一个邻居对我们没有取得的结果很有启发: Dahlem等人(2026年)展示了注意力操作者继承在幻觉检测中错乱的反应长度的光谱诊断. 我们对此也抱有同样的期望;相关证据是压倒一切的,而且一项干预拒绝了这一点(第4.3–4.4节)。

blocks.en: Méloux et al. (2025b) argue that mechanistic explanations are frequently non-identifiable, and Méloux et al. (2025a) show pipelines returning plausible explanations for randomly initialised networks, concluding that findings must be tested against explicit alternatives with quantified uncertainty; this paper is an instantiation. Méloux et al. (2025c) give the statistical form of our null band ( Quirke, 2026 ; Xu, 2026 , see also) , and that most heads prune without measurable loss ( Voita et al., 2019 ) makes an unmatched single random baseline uninformative. The closest methodological precedent is Kendiukhov (2026) , in genomics: top-ranked “regulatory” heads degrade nothing at any dose while twenty random heads do, with an intervention-fidelity check before the null is interpreted — a diagnostic we adopt (Section 3.2 ) — and its stated limitation is ours to address, that no positive control shows the pipeline can recover known causal structure. Our complement set is one: not the bottom of the ranking ( Yang et al., 2023 , cf.) but the top computed on the opposite label set . The construction is not exotic — Islam et al. (2026) already partition heads by score sign and ablate one side — so the family has the vocabulary for this control and has not run it.
blocks.zh: Méloux等人(2025年b)认为,机械解释往往无法识别,Méloux等人(2025年a)显示了对随机关闭的网络的可信解释的管道,结论是,必须对照有量化不确定性的明确替代品对结论进行测试;本文是即时说明。 Méloux et al.(2025c)给出了我们无效的波段的统计形式(Quirke, 2026;Xu, 2026, 也参见),并且大多数没有可测量损失的首级普鲁纳(Voita et al., 2019)使得一个无与伦比的单随机基准无法形成. 最接近的方法先例是Kendiukhov(2026年):在基因组学中,排名最高的“调控”头头在任何剂量下都不会降解任何物质,而二十个随机头头会降解,在解释无效之前先进行干预-忠诚检查——这是我们采用的诊断方法(第3.2节)——它所申明的局限性是我们要处理的,任何积极的控制都无法表明管道能够恢复已知的因果关系。 我们的辅助集是:不是排名的底部(Yang等人,2023年,参考),而是在相反的标签集上计算的顶部. 该建筑并非异国情调——伊斯兰教等人(2026年)已经用记分牌分割头目,并让一方退缩——因此家族有这种控制词汇,没有运行过.

blocks.en:
That our reverse set destroys refusal places it in mapped territory: refusal is mediated by an ablatable direction ( Arditi et al., 2024 ) localised to small head sets ( Huang et al., 2025 ; Yin et al., 2025 ) , and Zhao et al. (2025) select heads by the association between CoT length and attention ratio and show that ablating them weakens refusal. We claim its use as a validity argument, not the phenomenon: because this paradigm defines a fair response as a refusal ( Han et al., 2026 ) , a statistic recovering causal heads on the refusal side and nothing on the committal side is a statement about the construct. Blodgett et al. (2020) ; Blodgett et al. (2021) argue that bias measurements
frequently lack an articulated construct; we apply that critique one level
down, to the attribution built on such a measurement ( Cronbach and Meehl, 1955 ) . CoT
does not reliably reduce social bias ( Shaikh et al., 2023 ) , and persona
instructions substantially shift it ( Tseng et al., 2024 ) — our
manipulation check finds the persona worth 0.787 on the outcome measure
(Section 4.8 ).

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Setup
blocks.zh: 3.1 设置

blocks.en:
We audit contrastive head-level fairness attribution: elicit responses under
two prompting conditions, label them fair/unfair, compute a per-head score over
each label set, and ablate heads high for unfair but not fair. DiffHeads ( Han et al., 2026 ) is the instantiation we reproduce.

我们审计对比性头级公平归属:在下面引起答复
两个提示条件,标注它们公平/不公平,计算每个头的得分
每套标签, 并降低头高 不公平但不公平。 diffheads(Han et al., 2026)是我们再现的即时游戏.

blocks.en: Models. Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct ( Qwen Team, 2025 ) (28 layers × \times 28 heads) and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct ( Grattafiori et al., 2024 ) (32 layers, 32 query / 8 KV heads), both d h = 128 d_{h}=128 , run in 4-bit NF4 ( Dettmers et al., 2023 ) under Hugging Face Transformers ( Wolf et al., 2020 ) , greedy decoding. All prompts and generations are in English. All head-level operations index the input to o_proj by query head; grouped-query attention affects only the key–value pathway, and o_proj carries no bias, so zeroing an input slice exactly subtracts that head’s contribution.

blocks.en: Elicitation. Role-play forced choice between two social groups on a trait (“Who do you think is more trustworthy ? Men or women ?”) under a persona, in two styles: DA (no reasoning) and CoT (“Let’s think step by step”). Identification uses 60 questions × \times both styles at max_new = 128 , regenerated under three persona strengths (full, mild, none) because the persona strongly affects the outcome; evaluation uses 80 balanced held-out questions (8 protected pairs × \times 10) with no trait–pair overlap. Two earlier evaluation sets (Appendix A ) are used only for the degradation analysis.

blocks.en: Labelling. A response is unfair if it commits to one of the two groups, fair if it declines or hedges, and unclassifiable otherwise. The labeller inspects the opening 250 characters, with three negation-aware rules added after an audit of all stored responses (Appendix B ). Unlike the original, which uses an LLM judge without reported validation, we validate against human annotation on the evaluation data itself — 120 responses drawn blind and stratified across all 26 arm strata of both models’ evaluation files — so the validation applies to the results rather than to a predecessor instrument (Table 1 ). Agreement is 0.907 within the labeller’s fixed reading window and 0.696 beyond it, which bears asymmetrically on the arms (Limitations).

blocks.en: We build a length map from the same per-example scores, contrasting responses above and below median length while ignoring fairness labels. If the statistic measures bias the fairness map should be distinguishable from it. It is not: the two correlate at ρ = − 0.950 \rho=-0.950 on Qwen and − 0.768 -0.768 on Llama, and nine of the ten highest-scoring heads in the fairness map are among the ten most length-suppressed. blocks.en: 5.1 What the statistic measures
blocks.zh: 5.1 国家 统计措施

blocks.en: Rejecting the length hypothesis does not establish that the heads encode fairness. What remains is not attributable to the fairness construct, because within any single prompt the label, the response length and the presence of a protected-group token are collinear, the last partly by definition of the labelling rule. This is not a claim that bias is absent from attention heads, but a claim about what this procedure establishes on its own data: nothing that distinguishes the target construct from two surface correlates and one property of the prompt template. The failure is not repairable by better estimation: residualising length out of the contrast would remove the contrast. What would repair it is a different elicitation — scoring log-probabilities over fixed candidates, stratifying the contrast by length, or holding the prompt constant across label conditions — none of which is used in this family.
blocks.zh: 拒绝长度假说并不能确定头部编码公平. 剩下的部分不能归因于公平构思,因为在任何单一的标签中,响应长度和存在受保护的组令牌是连结的,最后一部分是根据标签规则的定义。 这并不是说注意头没有偏见,而是说这一程序在自己的数据中确定了什么:没有任何东西能区分目标构造与两个表面关联以及一个即时模板属性。 无法通过更好的估计来弥补故障:从对比度中剩余长度将消除对比度。 修复它的方法是不同的诱因——对固定候选人的对数概率进行评分,按长度划分对比,或者在标签条件之间保持即时常数——这些都不在这个家庭中使用。

blocks.en:
Two circularities, one of them in the equation. Heads are selected by a judge’s fair/unfair label and the intervention is evaluated by the same label. This is construct circularity rather than data leakage: it survives the original’s disjoint selection and evaluation sets, because one instrument defines both target and test. The field identified this early — Yang et al. (2023) observe that their statistic is the gradient of SEAT while their evaluation is SEAT, and re-evaluate under an independent metric — and their successors do not inherit the practice. A second
circularity sits inside the scoring equation: v ¯ ref \bar{v}_{\text{ref}} is
constructed from the response tokens and the score is then summed over response
tokens, so every head is measured against a target it partly wrote. Both are compounded by the collinearity above: selection and evaluation partly measure the same surface properties, so a method can appear to work by shifting response form at either stage (Sections 4.6 – 4.7 ).
blocks.zh:
两个圆形,一个在方程中. 头部由法官的公平/不公平标签选定,干预由同一标签评价。 这是构造循环性而不是数据泄漏:它是在原始的不相连的选集和评价集中生存下来的,因为一个工具既定义了目标,也定义了测试。 现场查明了这个早期——杨等人(2023年)观察到,他们的统计数据是SEAT的梯度,而他们的评价则是SEAT的梯度,并且根据独立的衡量标准重新评价,他们的继任者不会继承这种做法. 一秒钟

由响应符号构建,然后在响应中进行总和
标志,所以每个头 被测量到目标 它的部分写。 两者都因上述对等性而更为复杂:选择和评价部分衡量相同的表面特性,因此一种方法在任一阶段都可以通过改变反应形式而发挥作用(第4.6至4.7节)。

blocks.en: This licenses the causal null: the same score, construction, masking code, evaluation set and labeller that yield no effect for the prescribed set yield a replicated effect for its complement, so the null is a property of that set rather than of our scale. It is the positive control Kendiukhov (2026) identifies as missing from ablation-based audits, and differs from the closest precedent: Yang et al. (2023) mask the bottom of the same ranking under the same objective, testing whether the ranking is ordered, where ours is the top under the opposite label, testing whether the pipeline detects anything at all.
blocks.zh: 这种许可的因果无效:同分数、构造、遮盖码、评价套件和标签器一样,对规定的套件不产生任何效果的,则产生对其补充的复制效果,所以无效者是该套件的财产,而不是我们的规模。 Kendiukhov(2026年)被确认为基于停产的审计缺失, Yang et al. (2023)掩盖同一目标下同一排名的底部,测试排名是否命令,在反标下我们的排名是最高的,测试管道是否探测到任何东西.

blocks.en: The asymmetry is not general, and its failure is informative. Under one of the two reference readings on Qwen the prescribed set and its disjoint complement produce identical profiles; the asymmetry holds in two of three evaluable cells. We read this as favouring the interpretation that the contrast carries information about refusal behaviour rather than stereotype content: if both sides of the set difference select heads whose ablation destroys refusal, the statistic is not separating bias-carrying from fairness-carrying heads. We claim the control, not the mechanism.
blocks.zh: 非对称性不是一般的,它的失败是信息化的. 根据Quen上的两次参考读数之一,规定的集及其脱节补充产生相同的剖面图;不对称存在于三个可评价单元格中的两个。 我们读到这一点时倾向于这样的解释,即这种对比带有关于拒绝行为的信息,而不是陈规定型的内容:如果设定的分歧的双方都选择了那些破坏拒绝的人,那么统计数据并不是把偏见和公平主义的人分开。 我们声称控制,而不是机制。

blocks.en: 5.3 Scope, and what this family should report
blocks.zh: 5.3 范围以及这个家庭应报告什么

blocks.en: The family has seen both hazards and acted on neither. Dasu et al. (2026) state that dropping attention heads increases perplexity and lowers measured bias because degenerate text is low-bias by default, their tables showing random pruning with the best bias score in its row at a perplexity six orders of magnitude above baseline, and Zayed et al. (2023) report random baselines producing visibly less coherent continuations on the bias-evaluation prompts. Both are qualitative remarks in appendices, and no paper in the family measures generation quality on its evaluation set, quantifies a degeneracy rate, or excludes broken generations from the denominator. On nulls, the random arms that exist are a point estimate at one pruning ratio or the best of several draws; our band moves refusal behaviour in both directions, so a single draw is uninformative about magnitude and sign alike.
blocks.zh: 家庭既看到了危险,也没有采取行动。 达苏等. (2026)指出,降低注意力头会增加迷惑性,降低测量偏差,因为变质的文本默认是低偏差,他们的表格显示其排行中的最佳偏差分数为比基线高6个偏差级,Zayed等人. (2023年)报告了随机基线,这些基线在偏见-评价提示上的延续明显不连贯。 两者都是附录中的定性说明,家庭没有任何文件衡量其评价集的生成质量,量化变质率,或者将断代排除在分母之外。 在无线上,现存的随机臂是一普鲁因比或数张图中最佳的点估计;我们的波段在双向移动拒绝行为,所以单张图对于量和符号都无动于衷.

blocks.en: Scope. Response length is a confound only where the statistic is computed over generated responses partitioned by a judge label; minimal-pair methods ( Jahan, 2026 ; Yang et al., 2023 ) equalise response form by construction. The identifiability problem is broader: any procedure partitioning outputs by a judge’s label inherits whatever that label is collinear with, and minimal-pair designs trade one collinearity for another — with only the attribute word varying, the label is near-definitionally the attribute token’s presence, the degeneracy we measure at ϕ = 0.95 \phi=0.95 . We do not read our result as confined to the one design we measured directly.
blocks.zh: 范围。 反应长度只有在对法官标签分割的生成的响应数字进行计算时才产生混乱;最低补偿方法(Jahan, 2026年;Yang等人, 2023年)按构造等效反应形式。 识别性问题更为广泛:法官标签的任何程序分割输出都继承了与该标签相连的任何内容,最小的平面设计则将一个对应物交换给另一个对应物——只有属性词不同,标签几乎被定义为属性符的存在,我们测量的退化性为 = 0.95\phi=0.95。 我们不认为我们的结果仅限于我们直接衡量的一个设计。

blocks.en: What a method in this family should report. Three diagnostics, none currently standard: a control map built from the same per-example scores under an explicit alternative partition; a null distribution of ten or more matched component sets, reported as a band; and a degeneracy screen with an explicit denominator convention on the evaluation set itself — plus, where the construction permits, a complement-set positive control (Section 4.6 ). We add a fourth, which our own results establish and which we did not anticipate. A correlational control map is necessary and not sufficient. Ours returned ρ = − 0.950 \rho=-0.950 for an alternative hypothesis that a subsequent intervention rejected, and every additional correlational control we ran — across two models, three persona strengths, two style restrictions and a fixed scoring window — agreed with the wrong answer. Where a candidate confound is identified the coupling must be broken experimentally: a correlational diagnostic can establish that a statistic is confounded, never with what.
blocks.zh: 这个家庭应该怎么报告 三种诊断,目前无标准:在明确的备选分区下,用相同的每例分数制成的控制图;10套或10套以上匹配的元件的无效分布,报告为带状;以及带有关于评价本身的分母的变质屏幕,加上在施工允许的情况下,补充的一套正控制(第4.6节)。 我们补充第四个,我们自己的成果已经确立,我们没有预料到。 相关控制地图是必要的,但还不够。 我们的返回 = - 0.950\rho= -0.950 对于另一种假设,即随后的干预拒绝了,我们所运行的每一个额外的相关控制——跨越两个模型,三个人种优势,两个风格限制和一个固定的积分窗口——都与错误的答案一致. 如果一个候选人被确认为错位,则必须试验性地打破连结:一个相关诊断可以确定一个统计数据是错位的,而不是什么。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
We asked what a contrastive head-attribution statistic for social bias measures.
The answer we first arrived at was wrong, and the way it was wrong is the
paper’s most transferable result: a control map built under an explicit
alternative hypothesis — the diagnostic this literature lacks — returned − 0.950 -0.950 with response length, survived every further correlational control we
could construct, and was rejected by the first intervention we ran. What the statistic tracks is prompt identity; what it cannot be shown to track is the fairness construct, which no method in this family runs the experiment to separate. The substantive claims fail independently. None of this shows that social bias cannot be localised in attention heads, only that this procedure does not establish that it has been — and that the diagnostics which would reveal as much cost minutes (Section 5.3 ).

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en:
Scale and scope. Our identification set is 60 questions against
the original’s 2,516, and we use a validated rule-based labeller rather
than an LLM judge. We cannot fully separate “the method does not
replicate” from “the reduction loses the effect”; map reliability
above 0.95 and the complement-set positive control (Section 4.6 ) argue
against the latter, but the objection cannot be eliminated. The length
hypothesis is tested on one member of the generative, judge-labelled
subfamily — the only one we identified — so the construct-validity
critique generalises across the family while the intervention does not.

blocks.en:
Content. Our elicitation deliberately prompts models to make

measurement data. We report no generated text that names a real individual, and

blocks.en: B.18 Compute and software
blocks.zh: B.18 计算和软件

blocks.en:
No model was trained or fine-tuned. All experiments are inference only: greedy
decoding at max_new = 128 , two instruction-tuned models of 7B and 8B
parameters, loaded in 4-bit NF4 ( Dettmers et al., 2023 ) through Hugging Face
Transformers ( Wolf et al., 2020 ) with the output projection
dequantised for scoring. The study comprises roughly 2,000 generations across
identification, the four-arm length intervention and all evaluation arms on
both models; every bootstrap, re-split and labeller re-derivation reported here
is arithmetic over stored score arrays and required no further model
evaluation.
